1_executive_email.body:
Dear Neuro-navigation company (same as P-21) Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Neuro-navigation company (same as P-21).

## Technology
P-22 — Multi-segment shape-memory polymer catheter with autonomous navigation to

## Why This May Matter to Neuro-navigation company (same as P-21) or catheter OEM with smart catheter pipeline
Autonomous catheter navigation reduces placement complications and OR time. Closed-loop control is the next generation of smart catheters.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- Buckling: catheter WILL buckle before reaching actuation force limit (82x exceedance)
- Control stability NOT modeled (30s delay makes PID unstable)
- Tissue safety: effective force 0.039 N exceeds estimated damage threshold 0.01 N by 4x

## What We Are Asking
Commission the decisive experiment ($15-30K (ESTIMATED: SMP prototype + tissue phantom + force sensors)) OR request technical diligence OR request co-development discussion. Licensing is a subsequent route after successful validation.

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$20-50K, 18-36 months to T2 (4 control problems)) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular
